name: Jefferson County, NY
findings: Jefferson County has 323 nonprofit organizations. 177 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 146 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Jefferson County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
